design.sampling: deterministic stratified Latin hypercube; no random row split
design.split_policy: fixed calibration/validation/test IDs with held-out seed, scan, range, mismatch-strength and mechanism-family controls
design.paired_background: zero-impairment C+N generated once per scene and reused by target-off, target-on and representative target-only roles

null_gate.source: zero-mismatch C+N raw-observable null population only

target_contamination.definition: target-on estimator minus exact paired target-off estimator from raw observables

oracle_recovery.definition: known-parameter M1/M2 evaluation oracle headroom, deterministic gain, remaining gap and gain/headroom ratio

ai_gate.pre_registered_rule: M1/M2 NO_GO when median Oracle recovery ratio >=0.80, the 95% bootstrap CI lower bound is >=0.80, and no held-out fixed-Pfa regression; reopen only for a stable CI-bounded residual gap.

formal_questions.Q1_joint_m1_m2: answered by J3/J4 vs Oracle_Known_Joint in held-out test rows
formal_questions.Q2_m3_protection: answered by DECORRELATED state/fallback and M3 test rows
formal_questions.Q3_target_contamination: answered by estimator_target_bias.csv and paired target rows
formal_questions.Q4_global_pfa: answered by frozen calibration thresholds and held-out test metrics
formal_questions.Q6_ai_gate: answered by the pre-registered ai_gate decision
